Introduction

This media and communications degree encourage students to think and work critically and creatively within a wide range of contemporary media and cultural practices.

Students will also have the option of becoming a student member with Singapore Press Club (SPC).

Students will be touching on the key areas of: screen, new and digital media, global and international contexts of media and culture, creative industries, media history and theory, media and cultural research, and media and cultural production.

Course Highlights

  • Learn From Industry Practitioners

    Gain professional insights from our experienced lecturers.

  • Direct Entry to Academic Year 2

    Receive module exemptions and complete a UK Honours degree in 16 months with a relevant polytechnic or private diploma qualification.

  • Hands-On Media Experience

    Operate Radio and TV equipment in a real studio setting.

  • Double Skillsets

    Learn skills and knowledge across media and communications
Potential Career Opportunities

Graduates may choose to pursue a future (but not limited to) in these departments/industries:

  • Multimedia & Digital Animation

  • Advertising, Public Relations & Corporate Communications

  • Audio/Sound Design & Engineering

  • Digital Film, Sound & Video Production

  • Full-Time

Duration

Students will be studying between 3 to 4 modules per trimester and complete within 16* to 28 months.
*Only for students with direct entry to academic year 2.

Lesson Duration

On average 1–3 hours per session; Class-paced

Learning Mode

Blended (In-Campus & Online)

Modules

Academic Year 1

  • Basic Concepts in Media Studies
  • Research Methodologies
  • Digital Media - Communities 
  • Contemporary Issues in Media - Representation
  • Student Creative Project
  • Academic Practice
  • Writing Media Narratives
  • Media History - An Introduction
  • Academic Writing for Arts and Humanities

Academic Year 2

  • Intermediate Concepts in Media Studies
  • Contemporary Issues in Media - Socio- Political Discourse
  • Media and Creative Industries
  • Media Industries Event
  • Digital Media - Systems and Networks
  • Film and Screen Studies
  • Academic Writing 2

Academic Year 3

  • Critical Concepts in Depth
  • Advanced Concepts in Media Studies
  • Digital Media - Transnational Identities
  • Research Design
  • Final Coursework
  • Academic Writing 3


Mode of Assessment

Assessment of this programme may include assignments, projects, and written examinations.

Assessment methods are subject to the University’s revision.

Intakes

Intake Months:

  • March
  • July
  • November

Minimum Class Size

  • 10

Maximum Candidature

  • If the course duration is 1 year, the maximum period of registration is 2 years
  • If the course duration is 2 years, the maximum period of registration is 4 years
  • If the course duration is 3 years, the maximum period of registration is 6 years

Graduation Requirements

Upon successful completion of all required modules, students will be awarded the Bachelor of Arts with Honours in Media and Communications from Coventry University.

  • Full-Time

Academic Requirements

Entry via Year 1

  • Three GCE A-Level subjects which must include a business-related subject such as Business, Economics, Mathematics or similar; or equivalent.
  • Successful completion of PSB Academy’s

• Certificate in Media and Communications

Entry via Year 2

  • Polytechnic Diploma in Communications, Media or similar; or
  • Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Communications, Media pathway programmes or equivalent, awarded by a recognised private education institution.

Note: Successful completion of the following PSB Academy’s Diploma programmes may be eligible for direct entry into Year 2.

  • Diploma in Graphic Design and Media
  • Diploma in Media and Communication
  • Diploma in Media and Communications (E-Learning)

Entry via Year 3

  • Applicants may be eligible for direct entry into Year 3 with a Polytechnic Diploma in a closely related discipline. Such applications will be considered on a case-by-case basis in consultation with Coventry University link tutors.

Applicants with any other non-standard qualifications may apply but will be assessed on a case-by-case basis by PSB Academy and Coventry University.

Minimum Age Requirement

  • 16 years old

English Language Requirements (Language Proficiency)

  •  English Language at GCE O-Level English Language, grade C or above; or
  • Successfully complete PSB Academy’s Certificate in English Proficiency Level 5; or
  • IELTS score of 6.0 overall or equivalent

  • Full-Time

Full-Time Course Fees

  • Course Fee: S$23,544.00 (Academic Year 2 Entry)
  • Course Fee: S$11,772.00 (Academic Year 3 Entry)

Payment Instalments: 2 per Academic Year

International Students

  • Course Fee: S$35,316.00 (Academic Year 1 Entry)
  • Course Fee: S$23,544.00 (Academic Year 2 Entry)
  • Course Fee: S$11,772.00 (Academic Year 3 Entry)

Payment Instalments: 1 per Academic Year

T&Cs apply, refer to : https://www.psb-academy.edu.sg/promotions-tcs
